Responsive Web Design: One Website, Many Screens


Websites live on phones, tablets, laptops, and desktops. Responsive Web Design (RWD) creates one flexible website that adapts to different screens.

Think Flexible


Layouts can change based on available space:

Desktop: Three columns Mobile: One column

Tools like Flexbox, CSS Grid, media queries, and clamp() help content resize, stack, and reorganize.

Design for Real Users


Mobile first design prioritizes essential content. Text, images, buttons, and menus should remain readable, fast, and easy to use across devices.

If someone needs surgeon level precision to tap your button, it probably needs some attention.

Test Everywhere


Check different screen sizes and devices for:


  • Tiny text
  • Broken navigation
  • Horizontal scrolling
  • Overlapping content
  • Difficult buttons
